## Description
Mobile web function is normal, except the layout somehow broken on the right side.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open the application on a mobile device
2. Navigate to the affected page/section
3. Observe the layout issue on the right side

## Expected Behavior
Layout should be responsive and properly aligned on mobile devices.

## Actual Behavior
The layout is broken/misaligned on the right side of the mobile view.
